title: erucastrum fruticulosum
intro: Erucastrum fruticulosum, commonly known as Long-stalked Rocket, is a flowering plant in the Brassicaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Erucastrum fruticulosum include isothiocyanates, which have been shown to have antimicrobial and anticancer properties, as well as other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids. The plant's health benefits and therapeutic actions make it a promising subject for further research in the field of medicine.
